summary: 908 Devices Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of NIRLAB SA for $15M headline price (subject to adjustments), consisting of $13M cash and 293,368 shares of 908 Devices common stock. The stock consideration was priced at the higher of the 30-day VWAP closing price or a $5.88 floor. An additional $8M in earn-out consideration is payable. The board deemed the terms fair and authorized the deal. Sellers provided customary representations; a general holdback secures post-closing obligations and releases after 12 months. The transaction closed on May 4, 2026. To watch: earn-out milestones and integration of NIRLAB's spectroscopy tech.
